title: Poppy: discover, sign in, call the API
lede: A personal agent identified by a URL discovers a Company, signs in through PingFederate with PKCE, then signs every request with a Poppy-Session. Each step below is one real request this app makes.

edges.label: authorize: client_id is a URL, PKCE

steps.title: Discover the Company
steps.what: The agent reads /.well-known/poppy.json and the protected-resource document from the one origin you typed, and checks what the spec requires.

steps.title: The Company answers
steps.what: Scopes with scope_hints, the issuer, and the APIs an agent may call. The resource must be exactly the Company origin.

steps.title: Ask to sign in
steps.what: The agent has no registered client. Its client_id is the URL of its own metadata document, and PingFederate fetches it. PKCE protects the code.

steps.title: Get a token
steps.what: The agent exchanges the code, proving who it is with a signed assertion (private_key_jwt). The token's client_id is the agent URL.

steps.title: Call the API
steps.what: Every request carries the token and a Poppy-Session: a delegation signed by the agent key, and a session signed by a short-lived delegated key.

steps.title: The Company verifies
steps.what: It checks the token, then the session (delegation, method, URL, token hash, no replay) and answers.
